en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a sandy open square or yard in a small town with wooden houses on both sides and a small octagonal pavilion-like structure in the center-right. A woman and children stand near a well or fountain. In the distant background, the tower of a larger church-like building rises above the roofs. Handwritten-style printed text in red appears at the top left of the image.
